historicalOnly: The proposed cadence semantics below were not effective in the active preprocessed-tensor path. The option and overlay helper have been removed. Preserve the earlier CPU-test record as historical evidence only.

semantics.interval0: Use the baseline generated config; inference on every input batch.
semantics.interval1: Run inference, then skip one consecutive input batch.
semantics.interval2: Run inference, then skip two consecutive input batches.
semantics.tracker: No pipeline stage removal or input-frame dropping; downstream NvDCF/MV3DT remains on the decoded-frame path.
semantics.engine: Same qualified engine, ONNX paths and model revision; this does not qualify the new scheduling policy.
semantics.overlay: Hash-checked copies of the five generated config files; infer.ini changes only interval and its local labels path; the baseline remains unchanged.
semantics.identity: Content-addressed overlay manifest records base file hashes, its own hashes and runtimeInference. The live worker log records runtime settings without source URLs.

operatorTrial.instruction: Preserve other runtime-tuning keys and explicitly set inferenceInterval to 1 for a controlled live trial. Root owns source-scoped restart and evaluation.
operatorTrial.rollback: Remove inferenceInterval or set it to 0, then perform the same source-scoped worker restart. Baseline generated files need no repair.

limits: Only short CPU controls using temporary fixtures and mocked launch were run. No actual live config overlay was generated, model request issued, worker restarted or image built by this agent.
Intervals are nvinfer batch skips, not a measured per-camera FPS guarantee. Uneven mux batches and upstream source cadence can affect per-camera observation rate.
The fixed detector tensor/preprocess size and downstream tracker cost remain. No speedup is claimed before useful decoded-image and tracking checks.

The current native observedThisFrame flag uses detector confidence. A live interval trial must verify skipped batches are marked prediction rather than detector observations; current-event/map freshness must remain honest.

Earlier asynchronous-rendering 18.18/13.63 FPS counters came from black decoded images and are rejected working-demo benchmarks. They establish no useful rendering ceiling; synchronous 540p requires fresh image and tracking verification.
Existing 20 GiB VSS reserve and runtime guard are unchanged. The separately disabled Isaac 23 GiB floor is unaffected.
